candidate.answerReason: The trip covers 100 miles in 50/60 + 50/40 = 25/12 hours, so its average speed is 48 miles per hour.

methods.label: Divide total distance by total time
methods.explanation:
Average speed is total distance divided by total travel time, so first find how long each leg takes. Since time equals distance divided by speed, the outward and return times are
\[
\frac{50}{60}=\frac{5}{6}\text{ hour},
\qquad
\frac{50}{40}=\frac{5}{4}\text{ hours}.
\]
The total time is therefore
\[
\frac{5}{6}+\frac{5}{4}
=\frac{10}{12}+\frac{15}{12}
=\frac{25}{12}\text{ hours}.
\]
Bonnie travels \(50+50=100\) miles altogether. Her average speed is
\[
100\div\frac{25}{12}
=100\cdot\frac{12}{25}
=48\text{ miles per hour}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{48}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
